scenario.test: a saved voyage spends its last provisions before hulls and passengers waste, then refills within harbor supply
scenario.authoredSetup: navalCampaign replaces the full terrain with a two-island archipelago, derives water depth, explicitly clears resource deposits, funds two harbor settlements and assigns fleets/cargo. This journey removes the enemy fleet, researches Ocean navigation and embarks the caravan/guard through simulation commands, then authors the loaded carrier and passengers at water hex 786 with two provision turns before import. Subsequent movements, end turns and save/load use real player controls. This is scenario coverage, not an organic AI voyage or campaign pacing result.
